adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.footwork: Feet akimbo with knees extended backwards.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Single-file line passing under a horizontal bar.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso bent backwards; hip movement is central to the technique.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Levels decrease as the bar is lowered.
movement_profile.posture: Backwards arch with chest facing the sky.

signature_moves.description: Bending the back towards the floor while moving forward under the bar.
signature_moves.name: The Arch

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Touching the bar, touching the floor with hands, or turning the head/neck to the side.

music_profile.sound_description: Characterized by driving Afro-Caribbean percussion rhythms that provide a steady pulse for the dancer's movements.

basic_steps: Approach the bar with feet akimbo.
Lower the body while leaning backwards.
Extend knees backwards while passing under the bar.
Maintain balance without touching the ground with hands.
teaching.level_notes: Difficulty increases as the bar is lowered.
